name: Fix the Service Elevator
desc: The car is dead between floors. Nothing above the common floor is reachable until it moves.
board_line: The tower runs on that elevator. Everything else waits on it.

intro_scene.title: J.A.R.V.I.S.
lines: "Good morning. Before you ask - no, the elevator is not working, and yes, I have tried asking it nicely."
"The car is dead between the common floor and everything above it. Until it moves, this floor is the entire tower as far as you are concerned."
"I can tell you what it needs. I cannot tell you where the pieces went - the building was turned over rather thoroughly and my inventory of it is, frankly, fiction."
"A contactor relay, a length of cable, and a capacitor. They are in this building somewhere. Beyond that you know precisely as much as I do."

scene.title: Agent Coulson
lines: "A contactor relay." Coulson turns it over once and hands it across. "It was in the debris by the stairwell. I was going to bin it."
"For the record, I did ask what it was for. J.A.R.V.I.S. said, and I quote, 'nothing important.'"
"Go and make the elevator work. I'd like to stop taking the stairs."

part_message: A coil of cable and one very tired capacitor.
done_message: The elevator grinds, thinks about it, and opens. The tower is yours again.

name: Get the Quinjet Airworthy
desc: The port nacelle is in pieces and the pieces are all over the tower. No jet, no missions.
board_line: Pepper's job. Parts are scattered across three floors.

intro_scene.title: Pepper Potts
lines: Pepper is already talking, tablet in one hand, coffee she has not touched in the other.
"Good. You can reach me again. Now the bad news - the Quinjet doesn't fly."
"Whatever came through here took the port nacelle apart looking for something, and half of what they pulled out is scattered through this building."
"Find the pieces. All of them. Until that jet is airworthy, nothing S.H.I.E.L.D. sends us is a mission - it's a phone call we can't answer."

part_message: Another piece of the nacelle, exactly where nobody would put it on purpose.
done_message: The Quinjet spins up, holds, and settles. You can leave the block again.

done_scene.title: Pepper Potts
lines: The nacelle catches on the second try and stays caught. Pepper watches the readout for a long ten seconds before she lets herself breathe.
"Airworthy. Don't make me regret signing that."
"One more thing - I locked the assignment board while the tower was falling apart, because the last thing we needed was people volunteering for errands in a building with no lift."
"It's open now. There's a list of things down there that still don't work. Take them one at a time."

name: Restore the Training Floor
desc: Torn mats, a rack with a cracked frame, and a heavy bag on the floor. Nobody's training on that.
board_line: Nobody gets stronger until the mats are down and the rack is bolted straight.
part_message: Mat sections, bolts, and a frame that has seen better decades.
done_message: Mats down, rack straight, bag hung. The training floor is open.

name: Open the Med Bay
desc: The Med Bay still has power and nothing else. Get a treatment station running.
board_line: Somewhere to patch up that isn't a cot and a bad attitude.
part_message: Sterile packs, a diagnostic head, and a chair that mostly reclines.
done_message: The Med Bay comes up green. Sit in the chair and it will do the rest.

name: Restart the Tech Lab
desc: Tony's fabricators are cold. Warm them up and the tower can build its own gear.
board_line: Cold fabricators. Gear has to come from somewhere.
part_message: Fabricator feedstock and a toolhead that hasn't been dropped.
done_message: The bench lights up. The Tech Lab can outfit the team.

name: Get Into the Pym Lab
desc: Lang's code opens the door. What's behind it hasn't been powered since Hank left.
board_line: Scott has the code. The lab behind it is another matter.
part_message: Shrunken crates the size of sugar cubes, and one that isn't.
done_message: The Pym bench hums awake. Whatever Hank was doing down here, you can finish it.
